name: EA SPORTS FC (broadcast camera)

validation.notes: Written from general knowledge of the default broadcast scoreboard and match-facts screen. Not yet checked against live captures of the current edition; scoreboard reading and zone estimates must be validated before this pack is marked community or verified.

capture.notes: Use the default broadcast (or tele-broadcast) camera with the scoreboard visible. Other cameras reduce zone accuracy.

modes.label: Ultimate Team: Squad Battles (vs CPU, ranked rewards)

playerContext.label: Your side on the scoreboard
playerContext.help: The home team is shown on the left of the scoreboard.

playerContext.label: Your team (as shown on the scoreboard)
playerContext.help: Optional: the 3-letter abbreviation, so the recogniser can tell your goals from the opponent's.

vision.purpose: EA SPORTS FC match on the broadcast camera. Read the scoreboard (top-left: home abbreviation, home score, away score, away abbreviation, match clock). Recognise goals (goal celebration, GOAL graphic, or a goal replay marked REPLAY), clear losses of possession by the player's team, and the end-of-match statistics screen. The player's side and team are given in the context; left and right on the pitch are always from the perspective of the team defending that goal, looking out at the pitch.

state.label: Home score
state.description: Home team goals on the scoreboard (left number).

state.label: Away score
state.description: Away team goals on the scoreboard (right number).

state.label: Match minute
state.description: The minute shown on the match clock.

state.label: Possession %
state.description: Only on a statistics screen: the player's team's possession percentage.

state.label: Shots
state.description: Only on a statistics screen: the player's team's shots.

state.label: Shots on target
state.description: Only on a statistics screen: the player's team's shots on target.

state.label: Pass accuracy %
state.description: Only on a statistics screen: the player's team's pass accuracy percentage.

state.label: Expected goals (xG)
state.description: Only on a statistics screen, and only if xG is shown: the player's team's expected goals.

events.label: Goal (seen)
events.description: A goal is being celebrated, a GOAL graphic is shown, or a goal replay is playing. Report who scored relative to the player, where the final shot was taken from (zone in the goal area of the goal it went into), and how the goal was created if it is visible.

attributes.description: Whether the player's team or the opponent scored.
How the chance was created, only if visible in the replay.

events.label: Lost possession
events.description: In this frame the player's team clearly loses the ball to the opponent (interception, tackle, or a misplaced pass reaching an opponent).

attributes.description: How possession was lost, if visible.

zones.label: Where the goal came from
zones.description: Where the final shot was taken from, relative to the goal it went into. Left and right are from the defending goalkeeper's point of view, looking out at the pitch. 'Inside the box' means the penalty area.

zones.label: Pitch third
zones.description: Thirds of the pitch relative to the player's team: defensive third is nearest the player's own goal. Left and right are from the player's team's attacking direction.

responses.label: lost in your own third
responses.phrase: it was in your own third

noResponse.label: lost further up
noResponse.phrase: it was further up the pitch

concepts.title: Hold your defensive shape
concepts.summary: Many goals come from defenders pulled out of position. Containing the ball carrier while your line stays compact usually concedes fewer clear chances than chasing.
good: Jockey and contain the ball carrier
Switch to the defender covering the passing lane
bad: Pulling a centre-back out to press high
Sprinting at the ball carrier and getting beaten
Leaving the space behind a full-back open

concepts.title: Covering crosses and cutbacks
concepts.summary: When the ball goes wide, the most dangerous space is often the penalty spot area for a cutback, not just the near post.
good: Cover the cutback zone when the ball reaches the byline
bad: Ball-watching while a runner arrives unmarked
Every defender drawn to the near post

concepts.title: Lower risk near your own goal
concepts.summary: Losing the ball in your own third gives the opponent a short route to goal. Simple passes or clearances under pressure reduce that risk.
good: Simple passes when pressed near your box
Clearing when no safe pass is on
bad: Risky passes across your own box
Dribbling out of defence under pressure

concepts.title: Patient build-up
concepts.summary: Recycling the ball when forward options are covered keeps possession and pass accuracy higher than forcing passes into crowded areas.
good: Switch play to the open side
Recycle to a centre-back to reset
bad: Forcing through balls into crowded areas

concepts.title: Shot selection
concepts.summary: Shots from inside the box with space convert far more often than speculative long shots.
good: Work the ball into the box
Shoot when you have a clear sight of goal
bad: Shooting from tight angles when a pass is on

prohibitedAdvice: Exploits, glitches, or anything against EA's rules
Anything about the opponent that is not visible on the player's own screen
Live instructions during online or competitive matches

limitations: Frames are sampled about every 2.5 seconds, so many turnovers are missed; turnover maps show a sample, not every lost ball.
Goal locations come from replays on the broadcast camera and are approximate (six zones).
Goals are counted from scoreboard changes; if the scoreboard cannot be read, goals may be missed.
Pass accuracy and possession come from the statistics screen, so they are only known if that screen is shown.
failClosed: Scoreboard unreadable: no goals are counted from score changes.
Non-broadcast camera, menus or replays of other matches: no zones are recorded.
